name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
    <description>
        A map of the parameters of the Gray-Scott system. Here chemical 'c' increases from left to 
        right and controls the 'k' parameter, and chemical 'd' increases from bottom to top and 
        controls the 'F' parameter. For more detail, see:
        <a href="http://mrob.com/pub/comp/xmorphia/index.html">http://mrob.com/pub/comp/xmorphia/index.html</a>
        
        Edit the <i>linear_gradient</i> elements in the file to zoom in on a particular area.
    </description>

    <rule type="formula" name="Gray-Scott" wrap="0">
        
      <param name="timestep"> 0.2    </param>
      <param name="diff">     0.07  </param>

      <formula number_of_chemicals="4">
        delta_a = 2.0f * diff * laplacian_a - a*b*b + d*(1.0f-a);
        delta_b = diff * laplacian_b + a*b*b - (d+c)*b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="1" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <white_noise low="0" high="1" />
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.2" z="0.6" />
          <point3D x="0.4" y="0.5" z="0.8" />
        </rectangle>
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <!-- horizontal gradient increasing from left to right: -->
        <linear_gradient val1="0.03" val2="0.07">
          <point3d x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="1" y="0" z="0" />
        </linear_gradient>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="d">
        <overwrite />
        <!-- vertical gradient increasing from bottom to top: -->
        <linear_gradient val1="0" val2="0.1">
          <point3d x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3d x="0" y="1" z="0" />
        </linear_gradient>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
        <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
        <show_multiple_chemicals value="false" />
        <active_chemical value="b" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
